description: Schedules an existing text (up to 500 characters) at publish_at, or at the next best slot with auto_optimize_time:true (the two are mutually exclusive). publish_at takes any offset and comes back in UTC (Z); a publish_at more than 60 seconds in the past returns 400 publish_at_in_past with server_now. The same account needs at least 10 minutes between scheduled posts: a closer publish_at returns 400 schedule_too_dense with nearest_publish_at. Checked against the account's content_rules: with enforce:block a violation returns 422 and nothing is scheduled; the post is checked again right before it publishes. Applies for text-only posts with a specific time or when the user wants the system to pick the time.

auto_optimize_time.description: Next best slot (mutually exclusive with publish_at)

name: schedule_text
title: Schedule a text post
